title: Conjugation of a Fourier character under negation
statement:
Let $k \ge 1$ and let $\omega_k = e^{2\pi i/k}$ be the primitive $k$-th root of unity, and for $a \in \mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z}$ write $\omega_k^{a}$ for the value $\omega_k$ raised to the canonical representative of $a$ in $\{0,\dots,k-1\}$. Then for every $a \in \mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z}$,
\[
\omega_k^{-a} = \overline{\omega_k^{a}},
\]
that is, replacing $a$ by its additive inverse conjugates the corresponding character value.
hypotheses_covered: k is nonzero (k ≥ 1), i.e. NeZero k
